description: This file contains a utility class 'IpAddressUtils' that provides a static method to retrieve the client's IP address from the current HTTP request context within the application.

classes.name: IpAddressUtils
classes.description: A utility class with static method(s) to extract client IP address from the request context.

methods.name: getClientIp
methods.description: Returns the client IP address from the current request's attributes, or an empty string if not available.
